mapper.select: SELECT BOARD_NO, DIVISION, USER_NO, USER_NM, GROUP_NO, GROUP_ORDER, TITLE, CONTENT, OPEN_YN, DATE_FORMAT(REG_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS REG_DATE, MODIFY_DATE, BOARD_DIVISION, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CBCI_BOARD WHERE GROUP_NO = ${GROUP_NO} AND DIVISION = ${DIVISION}) AS COMMENT_CNT FROM CBCI_BOARD WHERE GROUP_NO = ${GROUP_NO} AND DIVISION = ${DIVISION} ORDER BY GROUP_ORDER

SELECT FOUND_ROWS() AS CNT, RESULT_TB.*, (SELECT SELECT_NM FROM CBCI_SELECT_CODE WHERE SELECT_CD = RESULT_TB.BOARD_DIVISION_CODE GROUP BY SELECT_NM) AS BOARD_DIVISION FROM( SELECT @BOARD_ROWNUM := @BOARD_ROWNUM + 1 AS RNUM, CBT.BOARD_NO, CBT.GROUP_NO, CBT.GROUP_ORDER, CBT.TITLE, CBT.CONTENT, CBT.OPEN_YN, DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(CBT.REG_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d'), '%Y년 %m월 %d일') AS REG_DATE, CBT.USER_NO, CBT.USER_NM, CBT.DIVISION, CBT.BOARD_DIVISION AS BOARD_DIVISION_CODE, (SELECT COUNT(GROUP_NO) FROM CBCI_BOARD WHERE GROUP_NO = CBT.GROUP_NO AND GROUP_ORDER != 0) AS COMMENT_CNT FROM CBCI_BOARD CBT, (SELECT @BOARD_ROWNUM := 0) ROWNUM_TB WHERE GROUP_ORDER = 0 AND DIVISION = ${DIVISION} AND TITLE LIKE UPPER('%${keyword}%') ORDER BY BOARD_NO DESC ) RESULT_TB ORDER BY RNUM LIMIT ${dataCnt}, ${dataPerPage}
SELECT title, user_nm, DATE_FORMAT(reg_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') reg_date, content FROM CBCI_BOARD WHERE BOARD_NO = ${BOARD_NO}
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(GROUP_NO), 0) AS MAX_GROUP_NO FROM CBCI_BOARD WHERE DIVISION = ${DIVISION};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CBCI_BOARD ( GROUP_NO, GROUP_ORDER, TITLE, CONTENT, OPEN_YN, REG_DATE, USER_NO, USER_NM, DIVISION, BOARD_DIVISION ) VALUES ( ${GROUP_NO}, ${GROUP_ORDER}, #{TITLE}, #{CONTENT}, #{OPEN_YN}, DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), #{USER_NO}, #{WRITER}, #{DIVISION}, #{BOARD_DIVISION} )
mapper.update: UPDATE CBCI_BOARD SET TITLE = #{TITLE}, CONTENT = #{CONTENT}, OPEN_YN = #{OPEN_YN}, BOARD_DIVISION = #{BOARD_DIVISION}, MODIFY_DATE = DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') WHERE BOARD_NO = ${BOARD_NO}
